archival_memory.research_experience: I have been involved in undergraduate research since the end of my sophomore year, which has been an eye-opening experience. It has given me a glimpse into how knowledge is created in the tech world. I initially didn't see myself going down the research route, but after being offered a research assistant position in a lab focused on data visualization for big scientific datasets, I decided to take the leap. It turned out to be a great decision.
